latest_release.body:
### Added

- Added the default item category, which the items created from invoice and bill lines get instead of the category of the line ([#3442](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3442))
- Added the option to show the discount on the document total on a separate row in the income and expense reports ([6c1fc9fc3](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/6c1fc9fc3))
- Let a document type send its own payment notification ([4221b8cb0](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/4221b8cb0))

### Changed

- Fix N+1 issue in customer and vendor lists by eager loading item taxes ([#3426](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3426))
- Held the rules of the reconciliation page for the API and the bulk actions ([ff5a7c207](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/ff5a7c207))

### Fixed

- Fixed accrual reports counting documents before the discount on the total ([#3420](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3420))
- Fixed tax used on a transaction being deleted, disabled or retyped ([#3430](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3430))
- Fixed currency used by a vendor being deleted, disabled or recoded ([#3432](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3432))
- Fixed item taxes of documents created from recurring templates keeping the template's type ([#3434](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3434))
- Fixed accounts, customers and vendors used by a recurring template being deleted ([#3436](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3436))
- Enabling, disabling or bulk editing an item, contact or user deletes its taxes, contact persons or picture ([#3437](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/issues/3437))
- Fixed accounts and currencies in use failing to be enabled or disabled ([#3439](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3439))
- Akaunting 3.3.1 wizard stuck on currency step ([#3440](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/issues/3440))
- Fixed creating a reconciliation clearing transactions that were unchecked ([#3444](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3444))
- Fixed deleting or unreconciling a reconciliation that isn't reconciled clearing the transactions of another one ([#3445](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3445))
- Refused a reconciliation overlapping the period of a reconciled one ([16f57e5ed](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/16f57e5ed))
- Fixed the document discount being taken off only the filtered lines in the reports ([baaa1b89b](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/baaa1b89b))
- Fixed bulk updating customers and vendors deleting their contact persons and failing for those with recurring documents ([9ea81b577](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/9ea81b577))
- Fixed bulk updating accounts giving the first account's currency to the other selected accounts ([b464d2400](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/b464d2400))
- Fixed recurring invoice and bill imports stopping at item taxes ([9f5c1ca22](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/9f5c1ca22))
- Link imported transfers to existing transactions instead of creating duplicates ([085068f02](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/085068f02))
- Keep sub-categories under their parent when exporting and importing categories ([98001668b](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/98001668b))
- Stop exporting "N/A" as the category of a vendor with no category ([d0ac971b6](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/d0ac971b6))
- Sent the delete confirmations as POST with _method, as the forms do ([d6a792614](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/d6a792614))
- Fixed the bulk action bar offering enable / disable when every selected record already has that status ([3d7f70e66](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/commit/3d7f70e66))

detail.readme:
﻿# Akaunting™

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/akaunting/akaunting?label=release)](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/releases)
![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/akaunting/akaunting/total?label=downloads)
[![Tests](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/akaunting/akaunting/tests.yml?label=tests)](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/actions)

Online accounting software designed for small businesses and freelancers. Akaunting is built with modern technologies such as Laravel, VueJS, Tailwind, RESTful API etc. Thanks to its modular structure, Akaunting provides an awesome App Store for users and developers.

* [Home](https://akaunting.com) - The house of Akaunting
* [Forum](https://akaunting.com/forum) - Ask for support
* [Documentation](https://akaunting.com/hc/docs) - Learn how to use
* [Developer Portal](https://developer.akaunting.com) - Generate passive income
* [App Store](https://akaunting.com/apps) - Extend your Akaunting

## Requirements

* PHP 8.2 or higher
* Node.js 20, 22 or 24 (to build the assets)
* Database (e.g.: MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite)
* Web Server (eg: Apache, Nginx, IIS)
* [Other libraries](https://akaunting.com/hc/docs/on-premise/requirements/)

## Framework

Akaunting uses [Laravel](http://laravel.com), the best existing PHP framework, as the foundation framework and [Module](https://github.com/akaunting/module) package for Apps.

## Installation

* Clone the repository: `git clone https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting.git`
* Install dependencies: `composer install ; npm install ; npm run dev`
* Install Akaunting:

```bash
php artisan install --db-name="akaunting" --db-username="root" --db-password="pass" --admin-email="admin@company.com" --admin-password="123456"
```

* Create sample data (optional): `php artisan sample-data:seed`

Point the web server's document root at the project root, not at `public`.
Akaunting serves itself through the `index.php` in the project root and builds
its asset URLs accordingly.

> If you prefer, `php artisan serve` also works for a quick local run.

## Contributing

Please, be very clear on your commit messages and Pull Requests, empty Pull Request messages may be rejected without reason.

When contributing code to Akaunting, you must follow the PSR coding standards. The golden rule is: Imitate the existing Akaunting code.

Please note that this project is released with a [Contributor Code of Conduct](https://akaunting.com/conduct). *By participating in this project you agree to abide by its terms*.

## Changelog

Please see [Releases](../../releases) for more information about what has changed recently.

## Security

Please review [our security policy](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/security/policy) on how to report security vulnerabilities.

## Credits

* [Cüneyt Şentürk](https://github.com/cuneytsenturk)
